claims.claim: Agent serving assumed one large model decoding every step; SpecAgent's reviewer pattern halves that decoding load.
claims.summary_span: Agent serving assumed one large model decoding every step; SpecAgent's reviewer pattern halves that decoding load.
claims.source_span: the prevailing design has a single strong model generate every step... Because verification replaces autoregressive decoding with parallel prefill, the strong model decodes only short verdicts and occasional repairs rather than every step... roughly halving memory traffic and wall time
claims.note: 'Halves that decoding load' is a reasonable compression of the source's 'roughly halving memory traffic and wall time' combined with the strong model generating at most half as many tokens.
